Introduction

Kim Kyung-mo, better known as DPR CREAM, is a South Korean singer, rapper, composer & producer under Dream Perfect Regime.

He initially debuted in 2012 as a member of the group LAYBACKSOUND, alongside Hangyeol & U-Turn. During his time in the group, he notably contributed to BTS’ song “Where You From”.

Cream is well-known for his diverse musical style in addition to contributing to over 500 songs in the KOMCA database, which is the reason fans affectionately refer to him as 'DPR Mozart'. He has composed & contributed to many projects of his fellow DPR label mates, in addition to artists like Big Naughty, Beenzino, Code Kunst, Nucksal, HAON & Loco.

Prior to joining DPR in 2015, he adopted the moniker ‘CREAM’ inspired by American hip-hop group Wu Tang Clan's 1994 song “C.R.E.A.M” which is an acronym of the phrase "Cash Rules Everything Around Me”.

He made his solo debut as DPR CREAM on July 5, 2019, with the digital single "The Voyager 737". On May 3, 2024, he returned as a solo artist with his debut full-length album “psyche: red”.
